items.statement: Most studies of epilepsy self-management apps will define engagement by log-ins or days of use and follow it for three months or less.
items.rationale: Consistent with the methodological review (claim c2); decides whether any engagement target can be borrowed.
items.risks: Grey literature may use other definitions.

items.statement: Studies that added clinician review of app data will report longer engagement than studies of the app alone.
items.rationale: Clinician response appears in reasons for stopping (claim c3).

items.statement: Few studies will report engagement for older adults, low-income groups or people with intellectual disability.
items.rationale: Access gaps (claim c4) and trial exclusions.
items.risks: Subgroup data may exist only in supplements.

summary: Three mapping expectations; h1 selected as the organising expectation.
